target_customer: Fintech engineering teams, EMIs, money transmitters and stablecoin issuers that need to build and operate flows of funds
problem: Fintechs hand build ledgers and payment orchestration. Formance offers an open source programmable ledger plus connectivity, flows and reconciliation modules.
business_model: Open source core with paid managed hosting and enterprise modules
product_category: Financial infrastructure, ledger and payment flows

founders.name: Clément Salaün
founders.background_notes: PayPal Ventures release calls him former payments lead at Selency.

founders.name: Anne-Sybille Pradelles
founders.background_notes: Former COO of cybersecurity startup Alsid per the PayPal Ventures release; not listed on the YC page.

competitors.name: Modern Treasury
competitors.what: Payment operations platform with a developer ledger API
competitors.funding_then: Reported $2B valuation in 2021 and $183M raised in total per a third party profile

technical_complexity.rationale: A double entry ledger with atomic transactions, a purpose built scripting language and payment connectors is demanding to build correctly.

defensibility.rationale: A ledger sits at the core of a customer's money movement, so it is sticky, while an open source core can be forked.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows an incumbent copying the open source approach; the company grew revenue tenfold in the year to 2025-01 per The Paypers.

market_need_then: Fintech boom of 2021 created many companies needing custom flows of funds; the company says fintech engineers wanted to weave multiple rails with internal ledgers.

identity.visual_style: Clean developer focused with italic kickers above headings
identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and concise, for example The ledger your money deserves

rebrands.why: Not stated; a profile credits the agency Odi with the rebrand

branding.community_and_virality: Open source repository originally under the numary GitHub organization; no star count found.

brand_strength.rationale: Coherent developer brand with open source presence, but little press about the brand itself.

pivots.to: Platform with ledger, connectivity, flows and reconciliation modules
pivots.why: TechCrunch 2025-01 quotes the CTO about moving from one ledger product to a broader platform

outcome_analysis: Formance is active and raised a $21M Series A in 2025-01 after a reported tenfold revenue increase over 12 months, with about 20 customers per TechCrunch. It builds on an open source ledger that spreads through developer adoption, then expanded into a broader platform and now targets stablecoin and AI payments.
notes: One outlet reports a $3.1M pre-seed before the Series A; seen in a single snippet, unverified and not recorded as a round. A $30.9M total figure appears in one profile only. Co-founder Pradelles is not on the YC page; her role is from the PayPal Ventures release. Formance competitor source is a third party profile, undated beyond the 2021 valuation.
